cohort: The study participants were mothers with low-risk singleton pregnancies, consisting of 16 who delivered preterm and 46 who delivered at term.
finding: Lower LMW adiponectin and higher cortisone levels at 15 weeks gestation were associated with preterm birth, and a combination of HMW adiponectin, cortisol to cortisone ratio, cortisone, maternal height, age, and prepregnancy BMI most strongly predicted preterm birth.
cross-section timing: Maternal plasma samples were collected at 15 weeks 0 days gestation.
